scope.summary: Implement pixelate StudioLiveFilter kinds; cell-mosaic kinds reuse the studio-engine tessellation core shared with the vector engine (14.5), not a private per-filter impl (Voronoi + Crystallize differ only in cell-fill rule): Color Halftone (per-channel screens, dot 4-127, per-channel angles), Halftone Screen (dot/line/circular + continuous-tone), Crystallize (polygonal color cells), Facet (block clumping), Fragment (four-offset average), Mezzotint (dot/line/stroke type menu), Mosaic (square blocks), Pointillize (random dots on bg color), Voronoi (cell-mosaic tessellation).
acceptance_criteria: Color Halftone, Halftone Screen, Crystallize, Facet, Fragment, Mezzotint, Mosaic, Pointillize, Voronoi; shared tessellation core
expected_tests: test: Color Halftone per-channel angles; Crystallize/Voronoi share tessellation core (cell topology identical, fill rule differs); Mosaic block size

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Halftone/mosaic/cell set missing; tessellation forked per filter.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
